description: Adsorption Isotherm Fitter built as a Linear regression. Gas molecules sticking to a surface follow isotherms that relate the adsorbed amount to the gas pressure. The Langmuir form assumes a single molecular layer while the Freundlich form handles heterogeneous surfaces. Fits y = slope*x + intercept by closed-form least squares on seeded synthetic data and reports coefficients, R^2, and predictions.
resume_bullet: Built a Adsorption Isotherm Fitter linear regression in pure Python implementing closed-form least squares on seeded synthetic data; demo recovers known coefficients and reports R^2 with a prediction table.

title: First Order Kinetics Fitter: Linear Regression
description: First Order Kinetics Fitter built as a Linear regression. Electrophoretic mobility converts directly into zeta potential via the Smoluchowski equation. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
resume_bullet: Built a Zeta Potential Calculator CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.
